purpose: Define fail-closed production handling of aerosol-model uncertainty after verified AOPS v1 ordinal 37 and AFPF v1 ordinal 38, without allocating new science or inventing an aerosol climatology.

productionUncertaintyPolicy.candidateScenarioSetMeaning: Sensitivity/uncertainty support only; these five states are not asserted to be equally probable, exhaustive climatology, or validated location-specific priors.

tier0AodOnly.description: Measured or assumed AOD550 without independently validated aerosol-family or phase-function evidence.
tier0AodOnly.permitted: Use an explicit baseline plus set-valued aerosol scenario envelope over the validated production scenario support.
tier0AodOnly.forbidden: Choose one aerosol family from AOD alone or assign scenario probabilities without a separately frozen external prior.

tier1ExternalRegimeClassifier.description: Independent environmental/aerosol classification available before evaluating the modeled twilight result.
tier1ExternalRegimeClassifier.permitted: Restrict the scenario set only after the classifier, mapping, domain, and error behavior have been separately validated and version-bound.
tier1ExternalRegimeClassifier.forbidden: Use residual agreement with the target observation to choose the aerosol family post hoc.

tier2DirectOpticalConstraint.description: Independent aerosol optical/microphysical constraints beyond AOD, such as validated SSA/phase-function-related retrievals.
tier2DirectOpticalConstraint.permitted: Condition or narrow the scenario support only through a separately reviewed forward mapping with propagated retrieval uncertainty.
tier2DirectOpticalConstraint.forbidden: Treat a single retrieved scalar g as a complete replacement for wavelength-dependent phase-function evidence.

nextScientificExperimentGate.recommendedNextExperimentClass: Only after this policy review: freeze a production-domain aerosol scenario transport/interpolation validation experiment targeted at the specific gaps required by activationRequirements.
